Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class BorrowingDeadlineService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.BorrowingDeadlineService
public class BorrowingDeadlineService extends Object
UC12 Process Borrowing Deadlines (Task 1.6: auto-return; Task 1.8: due-date reminders): as time passes, buyers are reminded that a borrowed item is nearly due, and items whose borrowing period has ended are returned automatically.

Design (Lectures 15-16). The actor is the Timer, not a person: the active class BorrowingDeadlineTimer calls process() at least once a second. This is the use case's control class, so there is no logged-in user to check here. The entities are the borrow requests and their listings. What a return does to the listing and whom it notifies is the same as for a buyer's own return, so it is done by DealRules.returnItem(com.hkust.marketplace.models.BorrowRequest, boolean).

Running on another thread. process() is called from the timer's thread while the user works in the screens. All its changes are one DataStore.transaction(java.util.function.Supplier<T>), so a buyer who returns an item at the same moment either finds it borrowed or finds it returned, never half of each (Special Requirement 5).

  • Method Details

    • process

      public DeadlineReport process()
      One run of the use case, for the moment the store's clock shows now:
      1. {Send Reminders}: every borrowed item that has reached its reminder time and has had no reminder yet gets one, with the item title and the due date (step 2).
      2. {Return Item}: every borrowed item whose due date has come is returned automatically. The due date becomes the completion date, the listing is Live again unless the admin removed it (A1), and buyer and seller are notified (step 3).
      A borrowed item is an accepted borrow request that has not been returned. An item whose reminder time and due date have both come, for example because the app was closed in between, is reminded and then returned in the same run.
      Returns:
      what was done; DeadlineReport.NOTHING if no deadline was reached
